objective: Implement one production package session that derives the complete current plugin product from the canonical source snapshot, binds it to the current LiveContext and authority catalog, emits deterministic HUGPKG plus generated inventory bytes, and independently re-verifies the pair without installing or publishing it.

base_candidate.note: The shared worktree also contains disjoint in-progress repository-fit and evaluation leases. Preserve them and bind the final freeze to the then-current root HEAD.

dependencies: accepted package snapshot and generated-disposition capture
accepted deterministic HUGPKG encoder and verifier

semantic_symbols: PackageSnapshot effective packaged rows distinct from dependency-cache rows
generated_outputs: test-owned HUGPKG and generated inventory pairs below /private/tmp/hul-distribution-supported-package-087-* only
authorized_effects: source edits within the exact writable paths
read-only current repository and Git candidate inspection
offline Cargo builds and tests with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/hul-supported-package-production-087-target
prohibited_effects: staging, committing, rebasing, merging, or changing branches
repository package output or generated-authority adoption
host plugin install, cache, marketplace, app-registry, Plugins UI, discovery, or runtime mutation
network, publication, signing, release, destructive cleanup, or deletion
public command catalog, parser, dispatcher, claim, migration, or release-state changes

required_behavior: Capture one stable canonical package source through the accepted PackageCapture boundary and retain the exact effective packaged rows separately from dependency-cache rows.
Require exact 0.0.12 agreement between plugin-manifest-draft.json and .codex-plugin/plugin.json; neither document alone may establish package authority.

Bind context id, canonical candidate id, current authority catalog id, effective source rows, version, roles, modes, generated-disposition decisions, source tree digest, archive digest, and generated inventory digest in one immutable production artifact.

Include every effective current plugin member exactly once, include the supported plugin manifest as the sole Manifest role, preserve executable modes only for actual executable members, and reject unknown, duplicate, ambiguous, retained-context, unsafe, or missing rows.
Build HUGPKG and generated inventory byte-identically from independent clean captures of the same candidate, then decode and reinventory the artifact without trusting producer metadata.
Revalidate source, root, LiveContext, candidate, and catalog at finalization; reject mutate-restore, candidate drift, and mixed-session composition.
Keep inventory derivation and verification read-only. Package materialization may target only an already opened test-owned confined output root in this lease.
Expose one narrow crate-private integration interface and request, but do not apply, root reexports or public command wiring.

positive: two independent clean-context builds are byte-identical
HUGPKG decode plus independent reinventory matches every row and digest
supported manifest and draft version agreement
canonical skill, agent, executable, documentation, data, and generated-projection role mapping
bounded confined output pair publication and exact replay verification
inventory and verify paths preserve recursive tree and Git status
negative: missing or mismatched supported manifest and draft version
duplicate, case-colliding, ancestor-colliding, unknown, missing, or extra package member
retained context promoted as product content
symlink, hardlink, special file, unsafe mode, oversized entry, oversized package, and path escape
partial HUGPKG or inventory pair and same-version different-byte reuse
race_and_mutation: source mutate-restore and manifest swap during capture
candidate or catalog change before finalization
two package writers yield one exact winner or typed conflict
archive, inventory, context, candidate, catalog, version, mode, and row substitution
security_and_false_pass: secret-shaped and local-only paths never enter packaged rows
producer metadata cannot replace independent archive decode and reinventory
green source inventory without HUGPKG is insufficient
green HUGPKG without matching generated inventory is insufficient
package bytes never imply install, marketplace, discovery, runtime, readiness, or release

verification.format: Run rustfmt --edition 2024 --check only on leased Rust files.
verification.storage: Do not use the repository target directory. Stop and report immediately on ENOSPC; do not delete or clean any path.

required_fields: exact touched paths and semantic symbols
artifact-set formula and current SHA-256 values
exact commands, pass counts, failures, skips, and platform limits
worker_result.no_claim_statement: Candidate source implementation only. No claim of root adoption, public package command availability, repository package output, installed bytes, marketplace state, cache state, app registration, Plugins UI visibility, discovery, runtime, representative user journey, claim elevation, node closure, readiness, release, or completion.
